chunks.l2:
[tal-a19-v01] Now the initiation giving immediate departure is set forth: from that moment, or from enjoyment, at body's fall one may go to Śiva — so hinted in the Mālinīśāstra by the Great Lord.

[tal-a19-v10] Having performed all the aforesaid rite, from samaya-purity, he should place his blazing marma-scissors knife.

[tal-a19-v02] At body's fall, when death is near, from śaktipāta's clearness, having obtained Śāṃkara initiation: hence from the initiation-moment, the supreme.

[tal-a19-v03] The meaning 'may go to Śiva' was explained here, from prior-posterior discernment, by our venerable guru Śambhunātha.

[tal-a19-v04] When death is near and śaktipāta arises, there, in mild cases, by guru-service life may go to diminution.

[tal-a19-v05] Or else, through kin-friends-and-the-rest, the Omnipresent's [grace] falls; or before, the samayin has not at all obtained supreme initiation.

[tal-a19-v06] Even the initiated, desiring to abandon life-breaths, freed from affliction: the final guru should then perform immediate-departure initiation.

[tal-a19-v07] But not in immature impurity, nor even in remaining-karmic-body, should departure be performed: so set forth in the venerable Gahvara.

[tal-a19-v08] Having seen the disciple age-seized, oppressed by disease, having made depart, then he should join this one in the supreme principle.

[tal-a19-v09] In the qualifier-qualified relation, from desire-conduct-arrangement, the aforesaid things were here set forth by venerable Śambhunātha.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-:C19 atha śrītantrāloke ekānnaviṃśamāhnikam atha sadyaḥsamutkrāntipradā dīkṣā nirūpyate / tatkṣaṇāccopabhogādvā dehapāte śivaṃ vrajet / ityuktyā mālinīśāstre sūcitāsau maheśinā dehapāte samīpasthe śaktipātasphuṭatvataḥ / āsādya śāṃkarīṃ dīkṣāṃ tasmāddīkṣākṣaṇātparam śivaṃ vrajedityartho@tra pūrvāparavivecanāt / vyākhyātaḥ śrīmatāsmākaṃ guruṇā śambhumūrtinā yadā hyāsannamaraṇe śaktipātaḥ prajāyate / tatra mande@tha gurvādisevayāyuḥ kṣayaṃ vrajet athavā bandhumitrādidvārā sāsya vibhoḥ patet / pūrvaṃ vā samayī naiva parāṃ dīkṣāmavāptavān āptadīkṣo@pi vā prāṇāñjihāsuḥ kleśavarjitam / antyāngurustadā kuryātsadya+utkrāntidīkṣaṇam natvapakvamale nāpi śeṣakārmikavigrahe / kuryādutkramaṇaṃ śrīmadgahvare ca nirūpitam dṛṣṭvā śiṣyaṃ jarāgrastaṃ vyādhinā paripīḍitam / utkramayya tatastvenaṃ paratattve niyojayet viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatve kāmacāravidhānataḥ / pūrvoktamarthajātaṃ śrīśambhunātra nirūpitam vidhiṃ pūrvoditaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvā samayaśuddhitaḥ / kṣurikāmasya vinyasyejjvalantīṃ marmakartarīm

chunks.l2:
[tal-a19-v11] Having performed all the aforesaid nyāsa, equal-to-fire-of-time, by withdrawal-sequence together with the two scissors.

[tal-a19-v12] Having performed fire-natured dhāraṇā, all-marma-scorching: he should fill the body with breath from thumb to head-end.

[tal-a19-v13] Having drawn up from thumb to upper-end, by the to-be-spoken he should cut the marmas from the hole-end, by Kālarātrī dismiss.

[tal-a19-v14] By this sequential yoga, yoked, libation-abandoned: even the samayin goes to that initiation — thus in the Mālinī doctrine.

[tal-a19-v15] From sixteen-supports-six-wheels-three-targets-five-ether, or somewhere else, as before the beast-rite.

[tal-a19-v16] Having entered the root from the kanda-region, cutting from non-difference-discernment, by full-oblation use he should join in his own-desired abode.

[tal-a19-v17] Knowledge-trident, blazing, radiant-three-wheels-blazing: having meditated by that, his feeling, awakening, whirling.

[tal-a19-v18] Inflaming, striking, pricking, moving, again and again from-kanda-wheel-going: he should perform specially in the heart-lotus.

[tal-a19-v19] At the twelve-end, then, having performed, in the bindu-pair he should cast: in the unmarked or supreme abode, joined to the Supreme Lord.

[tal-a19-v20] Not should he perform any saṃskāra for him: thus says the god in the Gahvara — what of his full one, by śrāddha-and-the-rest considered?
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-kṛtvā pūrvoditaṃ nyāsaṃ kālānalasamaprabham / saṃhṛtikramataḥ sārdhaṃ sṛkchindiyugalena tu āgneyīṃ dhāraṇāṃ kṛtvā sarvamarmapratāpanīm / pūrayedvāyunā dehamaṅguṣṭhānmastakāntakam tamutkṛṣya tato@ṅguṣṭhādūrdhvāntaṃ vakṣyamāṇayā / kṛntenmarmāṇi randhrāntāt kālarātryā visarjayet anena kramayogena yojito hutivarjitaḥ / samayyapyeti tāṃ dīkṣāmiti śrīmālinīmate ṣoḍaśādhāraṣaṭcakralakṣyatrayakhapañcakāt / kvacidanyataratrātha prāguktapaśukarmavat praviśya mūlaṃ kandādeśchindannaikyavibhāvanāt / pūrṇāhutiprayogeṇa sveṣṭe dhāmni niyojayet jñānatriśūlaṃ saṃdīptaṃ dīptacakratrayojjvalam / cintayitvāmunā tasya vedanaṃ bodhanaṃ bhramam dīpanaṃ tāḍanaṃ todaṃ calanaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ / kandādicakragaṃ kuryādviśeṣeṇa hṛdambuje dvādaśānte tataḥ kṛtvā binduyugmagate kṣipet / nirlakṣye vā pare dhāmni saṃyuktaḥ parameśvaraḥ na tasya kuryātsaṃskāraṃ kaṃcidityāha gahvare / devaḥ kimasya pūrṇasya śrāddhādyairiti bhāvitaḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a19-v21] In the venerable Dīkṣottara this rite, fire-put-in: haṃsa, man below his, with Rudra-bindu.

[tal-a19-v22] In the disciple's body joined, this unagitated: a hundred should he mutter; having departed by upward blink, the disciple thus may go supreme.

[tal-a19-v23] This indeed is the rite in the venerable Siddhayogīśvarī doctrine: this departure-initiation to be performed by the yogin's guru.

[tal-a19-v24] Unpracticed in prāṇa-conduct, how will he perform this? The to-be-spoken Brahma-vidyā, with parts, partless-included.

[tal-a19-v25] In his ear, or should read again, again, or then should cause to read; himself and rite should perform, tattva-purity-and-the-rest, the guru.

[tal-a19-v26] By mantra-rite-force, full-oblation-thus, he should join to the supreme; without yoga-practice even, immediate-departure-giving, the guru.

[tal-a19-v27] By knowledge-mantra-rite-meditation-force to perform: should be able; by this is departed the disciple, by force alone, one moment.

[tal-a19-v28] Having transgressed time, enjoyment is momentary; what then? Immediate-departure-giving and another, in which full-oblation then.

[tal-a19-v29] Should give when his life-breaths would certainly be desiring to depart: even without rite, by forthcoming Brahma-vidyā force, the guru.

[tal-a19-v30] By ear-muttering use, from tattva-armor-net, liberating as desired: in with-parts, in partless, in both.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-śrīmaddīkṣottare tveṣa vidhirvahnipuṭīkṛtaḥ / haṃsaḥ pumānadhastasya rudrabindusamanvitaḥ śiṣyadehe niyojyaitadanudvagnaḥ śataṃ japet / utkramyordhvanimeṣeṇa śiṣya itthaṃ paraṃ vrajet eṣa eva vidhiḥ śrīmatsiddhayogīśvarīmate / iyamutkrāmaṇī dīkṣā kartavyā yogino guroḥ anabhyastaprāṇacāraḥ kathamenāṃ kariṣyati / vakṣyamāṇāṃ brahmavidyāṃ sakalāṃ niṣkalombhitām karṇe@sya vā paṭhedbhūyo bhūyo vāpyatha pāṭhayet / svayaṃ ca karma kurvīta tattvaśuddhyādikaṃ guruḥ mantrakriyābalātpūrṇāhutyetthaṃ yojayetpare / yogābhyāsamakṛtvāpi sadya+utkrāntidāṃ guruḥ jñānamantrakriyādhyānabalātkartuṃ bhavetprabhuḥ / anayotkramyate śiṣyo balādevaikakaṃ kṣaṇam kālasyollaṅghya bhogo hi kṣaṇiko@syāstu kiṃ tataḥ / sadya+utkrāntidā cānyā yasyāṃ pūrṇāhutiṃ tadā dadyādyadāsya prāṇāḥ syurdhruvaṃ niṣkramaṇecchavaḥ / vināpi kriyayā bhāvibrahmavidyābalādguruḥ karṇajāpaprayogeṇa tattvakañcukajālataḥ / niḥsārayanyathābhīṣṭe sakale niṣkale dvaye

chunks.l2:
[tal-a19-v31] In tattva, wherever, anywhere, he should join the person in sequence: samayin or putraka should read this vidyā, thus.

[tal-a19-v32] From its reading but, samaya-joined attains Rudra-share-arrival: these two in japa and in study, since both authorized.

[tal-a19-v33] In teaching or instructing, or: he, this study excepted — of these two reading, by its nature his, that course.

[tal-a19-v34] As forbidden-beings-and-the-rest actions, mantra remembering himself: even when possessed, somewhere does not go loss, from doership-abandoning.

[tal-a19-v35] As, and causing-to-recite scripture, samayin in empty-dwelling: not is lost, from that inner-beings-group-benefiting.

[tal-a19-v36] Thus himself reading this vidyā, from thing-nature: in that released not would be lost, since doing-something-here he.

[tal-a19-v37] Indeed before the uninitiated he should not recite scripture-method.

[tal-a19-v38] Well, before the wall even his: prohibition but now is told by exception, who to hear to ascertain is capable.

[tal-a19-v39] He indeed here is forbidden, not walls-insects-birds; then stone-like he, dissolved-sense-activity.

[tal-a19-v40] Before him, of him reading, prohibition-transgression how? He but, by thing-nature, even dissolved-eyed awakens.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-tattve vā yatra kutrāpi yojayetpudgalaṃ kramāt / samayī putrako vāpi paṭhedvidyāmimāṃ tathā tatpāṭhāttu samayyuktāṃ rudrāṃśāpattimaśnute / etau jape cādhyayane yasmādadhikṛtāvubhau nādhyāpanopadeśe vā sa eṣo@dhyayanādṛte / paṭhatostvanayorvastusvabhāvāttasya sā gatiḥ yathā niṣiddhabhūtādikarmā mantraṃ smaransvayam / āviṣṭe@pi kvacinnaiti lopaṃ kartṛtvavarjanāt yathā ca vācayañśāstraṃ samayī śūnyaveśmani / na lupyate tadantaḥsthaprāṇivargopakārataḥ tathā svayaṃ paṭhanneṣa vidyāṃ vastusvabhāvataḥ / tasminmukte na lupyeta yato kiṃcitkaro@tra saḥ nanu cādīkṣitāgre sa noccarecchāstrapaddhatim hanta kuḍyāgrato@pyasya niṣedhastvatha kathyate / paryudāsena yaḥ śrotumavadhārayituṃ kṣamaḥ sa evātra niṣiddho no kuḍyakīṭapatatriṇaḥ / tarhi pāṣāṇatulyo@sau vilīnendriyavṛttikaḥ tasyāgre paṭhatastasya niṣedhollaṅghanā katham / sa tu vastusvabhāvena galitākṣo@pi budhyate

chunks.l2:
[tal-a19-v41] By sense-independence inner consciousness-power, by self-luminous: prior body indeed desiring to abandon not supreme, and established.

[tal-a19-v42] In the middle, from awakening-force, would awaken the person: mantras, sound-made, by pure-reflection-nature itself.

[tal-a19-v43] By meaning-self, and shining that meaning-awakening: by that his, of dissolved-eyed, awakening arises itself.

[tal-a19-v44] From self-consciousness-same-kind-mantra-reflection-proximity: as indeed-small-speed wind, same-kind-mixed.

[tal-a19-v45] Speedy, so-self: sleeping-reflection even thus awakens; awakened he and born, not and-uninitiated, is called.

[tal-a19-v46] Initiation, for, name, saṃskāra: not but-other-is, and-his, for, hence indeed, own scripture reads somewhere in samaya.

[tal-a19-v47] Having heard that, someone if fortunate is liberated, not his that loss; scripture-censure let not this one do — of two fall-giving.

[tal-a19-v48] Thus supreme this, not uninitiated before, should read thus: as and samayin in wood, in clod, or mantra-joining.

[tal-a19-v49] Doing in that flutters thus: not loss, likewise here, for since his proof-arrival-desiring, of samayin thus.

[tal-a19-v50] Of one engaged, by nature, in that released: not indeed loss. But the sādhaka always in the to-be-accomplished fruit, from rule-constraint.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-akṣānapekṣayaivāntaścicchaktyā svaprakāśayā / prāgdehaṃ kila tityakṣurnottaraṃ cādhitaṣṭhivān madhye prabodhakabalāt pratibudhyet pudgalaḥ / mantrāḥ śabdamayāḥ śuddhavimarśātmatayā svayam arthātmanā cāvabhāntastadarthapratibodhakāḥ / tenāsya galitākṣasya prabodho jāyate svayam svacitsamānajātīyamantrāmarśanasaṃnidheḥ / yathā hyalpajavo vāyuḥ sajātīyavimiśritaḥ javī tathātmā saṃsuptāmarśo@pyevaṃ prabudhyate / prabuddhaḥ sa ca saṃjāto na cādīkṣita ucyate dīkṣā hi nāma saṃskāro na tvanyatso@sti cāsya hi / ata eva nijaṃ śāstraṃ paṭhati kvāpi sāmaye tacchrutvā ko@pi dhanyaścenmucyate nāsya sā kṣatiḥ / śāstranindāṃ maiṣa kārṣīddvayoḥ pātityadāyinīm ityevaṃparametannādīkṣitāgre paṭhediti / yathā ca samayī kāṣṭhe loṣṭe vā mantrayojanām kurvaṃstasmiṃścalatyeti na lopaṃ tadvadatra hi / yato@sya pratyayaprāptiprepsoḥ samayinastathā pravṛttasya svabhāvena tasminmukte na vai kṣatiḥ / sādhakastu sadā sādhye phale niyatiyantraṇāt

chunks.l2:
[tal-a19-v51] Even fly-heard mantra: expiation-fitness should perform. Thus immediate-departure is spoken, by that command of the guru.

[tal-a19-v52] Samayin and the rest even, at the spoken time, for the spoken meaning's accomplishment: himself should perform practiced prāṇa-conduct going-coming.

[tal-a19-v53] Unmade-authorized or even the guru, for samaya-purity, in lower-state: but not knowledge-kindled-conscious.

[tal-a19-v54] Thus this immediate-departure hinted in Mālinī-doctrine: himself or by the guru or then as to be performed by the Great Lord.

[tal-a19-v55] All enjoyment ugly, but having deemed, body should abandon if: then by that, quickly by sequence, joined, samayin, Śiva.

[tal-a19-v56] Spoken this immediate-departure, which to-be-guarded, by the wise like life.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-makṣikāśrutamantro@pi prāyaścittaucitīṃ caret / itthaṃ sadyaḥsamutkrāntiryoktā tāmājñayā guroḥ samayyādirapi proktakāle proktārthasiddhaye / svayaṃ kuryātsamabhyastaprāṇacāragamāgamaḥ akṛtādhikṛtirvāpi guruḥ samayaśuddhaye / adhastanapadāvastho natu jñāneddhacetanaḥ itīyaṃ sadya+utkrāntiḥ sūcitā mālinīmate / svayaṃ vā guruṇā vātha kāryatvena maheśinā sarvaṃ bhogaṃ virūpaṃ tu matvā dehaṃ tyajedyadi / tadā tena krameṇāśu yojitaḥ samayī śivaḥ ukteyaṃ sadya+utkrāntiryā gopyā prāṇavadbudhaiḥ
